WITH race_country_wins AS (
  SELECT c.country, r.raceId, AVG(ds.wins) AS race_avg_wins
  FROM races r
  JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
  JOIN driverStandings ds ON ds.raceId = r.raceId
  GROUP BY c.country, r.raceId
), country_averages AS (
  SELECT country, AVG(race_avg_wins) AS avg_wins
  FROM race_country_wins
  GROUP BY country
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS overall_avg
  FROM country_averages
), above_overall AS (
  SELECT ca.country, ca.avg_wins, o.overall_avg
  FROM country_averages ca CROSS JOIN overall o
  WHERE ca.avg_wins > o.overall_avg
), group_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS group_avg
  FROM above_overall
)
SELECT a.country,
       a.avg_wins,
       a.avg_wins - a.overall_avg AS above_overall_average,
       a.avg_wins - g.group_avg AS above_above_average_group_average
FROM above_overall a
CROSS JOIN group_average g
WHERE a.avg_wins > g.group_avg
ORDER BY a.country;
